# Vansh Sharma

Vansh Sharma is an early-career software engineer and full stack developer interested in useful web products, AI-powered applications, responsive interfaces, and interactive digital experiences.

## About

Vansh completed a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at S.D. College of Engineering & Technology (2022–2026, 8.2/10 CGPA). His documented experience includes a Full Stack Developer internship at Softiwa Technologies and a Web Development internship at Innovexis.

## Technical areas

- Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux Toolkit, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, JWT authentication, role-based access
- Data: MongoDB, Mongoose, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL
- AI and machine learning: LLM API integration, prompt engineering, Python, Flask, scikit-learn
- Creative development: Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP, ScrollTrigger, GLSL

## Selected projects

- Prompt2Site: AI website builder with a React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, MongoDB, LLM API integration, credits, and Razorpay payment workflows. [Live project](https://prompt2site-1-cvux.onrender.com/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/vanshsharma0058/Prompt2Site)
- DogStudio: interactive 3D web experience using React Three Fiber, Three.js, GSAP, ScrollTrigger, and shader effects. [Live project](https://dogstudio-3d-experience.vercel.app/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/vanshsharma0058/dogstudio-3d-experience)
- Digital Signature App: document-signing workflow with server-side PDF processing. [GitHub](https://github.com/vanshsharma0058/Digital-Signature-App)
- Employee Salary Predictor: a Python and Flask application using a linear regression workflow. [GitHub](https://github.com/vanshsharma0058/Employee-salary-predictor)
